founded-in-1922-tcssh.zh: 台中二中創校於1922年，起源於日治時期的台中中學校，中二中為台中四省中一員，現為中部五校聯盟。
founded-in-1922-tcssh.en: Founded in 1922, TCSSH originated from the Taichung Middle School during the Japanese colonial period. TCSSH is one of the "Four Great Provincial Schools" and is now part of the Central Taiwan Five Schools Alliance.

the-accessories-of-a.en: The Accessories of a TCSSH Student

tcssh-shirt-tcssh-pants.en: TCSSH Shirt, TCSSH Pants, School Bag

a-wise-tcssh-teacher.zh:
有一名智慧的二中教師曾云:
「你們唯一穿制服的時間應該是大學的制服日」
a-wise-tcssh-teacher.en:
A Wise TCSSH Teacher Once Said:
"The only time you should wear a uniform is during university uniform day."

alt.photo-from-the-first.zh: 第一屆清交聯合制服日活動照
alt.photo-from-the-first.en: Photo from the first joint NYCU-NTHU TCSSH uniform day

however-i-noticed-that.zh: 但是我發現到交大的學長都蠻懶惰的，於是我跟我清大的朋友興辦了第一屆的清交聯合中二中制服日。
however-i-noticed-that.en: However, I noticed that seniors at NYCU were quite lazy, so I organized the first joint TCSSH uniform day with my friend at NTHU.

alt.tcssh-centennial-celebration-animati.zh: 臺中二中百年校慶活動動畫

it-was-just-a.zh: 剛好是我高中畢業隔一年，交大作業還扛的住的時候有回到母校找老師。
it-was-just-a.en: It was just a year after I graduated from high school, and I was able to visit my teachers while still managing my university work.
